entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

covers: Regulatory and ethical considerations for AI implementation
Aligning AI initiatives with business objectives
Developing and implementing an AI management system
Evaluating quality, reliability, and performance of AI systems
Ensuring AI solutions meet standards and function as intended
Identifying and mitigating AI related risks
reading.summary: This credential relates to ISO/IEC 42001, the standard for an artificial intelligence management system. The training courses teach how to plan, develop, implement, maintain, and improve such a system. Holding the certificate shows the person can handle regulatory and ethical issues, align AI work with business goals, and manage AI related risks.
reading.audience: Individuals who want proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems.
